title: Criteria on forbidden subgraphs in the complements for positive Lin--Lu--Yau curvature
summary: We investigate forbidden subgraph conditions in the complement of a graph that guarantee positive Lin--Lu--Yau curvature. In particular, we prove that every graph whose complement contains no $4$-cycles has positive Lin--Lu--Yau curvature, with the only exception of the $4$-vertex path. We further prove that, for any integer $t\ge2$, every graph on at least $\max\{t^2-2t+2, 8t\}$ vertices whose complement contains no $K_{2,t}$ has positive curvature.
